title: KeepExp
description: A simple Fabric mod that prevents players from losing or dropping experience on death.
body:
KeepExp is a lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft

When a player dies, their experience level, progress, and total experience are preserved. The mod also prevents XP orbs from dropping on death, so players keep their XP cleanly without duplicating it.

Features:
- Keep XP after death
- Prevent XP orbs from dropping
- Lightweight and simple
- Built for Fabric
